description: Weekly dependency updates, held for 3 days after release (npm allows unpublishing within 72 hours, and a brand-new release is the riskiest supply-chain window), then automerged once CI passes. platformAutomerge is on because this public repo's branch protection requires CI.

packageRules.description: Group non-major updates of stable (>=1.0.0) packages into one weekly PR.
Group pin and digest updates into one PR.
Pin devDependencies to exact versions for reproducible builds.
This is a library, so peer ranges widen to admit new majors instead of pinning, which would force consumers onto one version.
Widening a peer range to a new major changes what consumers must support, so a human reviews it.
